svg.text: BUILT — Foundation batch, part 1: the test + RPS gate (v0.64.0)
From the 90-item backlog. Builds the harness that auto-verifies every later change — and on first run it caught a real legacy-parity bug.
🧪 RPS lint — the 'does legacy still work?' gate
tests/rps_lint.py scans every ui/*.html + *.js for ES6 SYNTAX (arrow, const/let, template,
spread, for-of, class, async/await) that polyfills can't fix.
ES5-required pages (mechanic-facing tools) FAIL the gate on any ES6; rich pages
(3D/WebGL/loupe/circuit sim) are modern-by-design and exempt (reported).
Run by RUN-ALL-TESTS.bat alongside the regression suites.
A change isn't done until legacy still runs.
🐞 ...and it caught one immediately
First run flagged status.html (the OCR/system dashboard, a legacy tool) as containing ES6:
arrow x5, const x13, let x3 + async/await.
On IE11 / Win7 that page would have thrown a SyntaxError and shown nothing.
Rewrote its script in clean ES5 (var / function / XHR). Re-verified: 0
arrow/const/let/template/async/await.
Real RPS bug found and fixed on day one.
🩺 /healthz endpoint
New GET /healthz returns the preflight checks as JSON (python/disk/DB integrity/schema/GPU).
Feeds the watchdog and a future ops status badge; 503 when a fatal check fails.
Stdlib, RPS-safe.
Machine-readable health in one call.
▶ RUN-ALL-TESTS.bat
One host-side command = regression suites + safeguard truncation/integrity verify + the RPS
lint.
Exit 0 only when additives pass AND legacy parity holds. /snapshot baselines first.
This is the 'test all additives and the retroactive' loop, automated.
One button: additives + retroactive, green or not.
VERIFIED: rps_lint compiles + ran against the real 20 UI files (all ES5-tier pages clean except the status.html it caught; modern pages correctly exempt). status.html re-checked ES5-clean.
/healthz + RUN-ALL-TESTS confirmed on host. Backlog items #2-4/#6/#8 (shared.js, base.css, patterns.py, diagram _common) + the route smoke test are the next Foundation increment.
BUILT diagram. Dark (R3). v0.64.0 · 2026-06-03 · tests/rps_lint.py · ui/status.html (ES5) · viewer_app.py /healthz · RUN-ALL-TESTS.bat. Additive (R1/R6).
